items.pap: The Network Development Program focuses specifically on the expansion and improvement of the national road network.It aims to expand the capacity of the national road network by constructing new roads that meet the functional classification criteria and improving the quality of existing national roads through various activities. Eligibility for later classification as a national road is determined by a feasibility study and the functional classification criteria set by DPWH. This is also achieved through a range of activities such as road widening, the construction of bypasses and diversion roads, the construction of missing links/new roads, the construction of flyovers, interchanges, underpasses, long-span bridges, off-carriageway improvement, and the paving of unpaved roads.The program includes several sub-programs aimed at achieving its objectives. This is also achieved through a range of activities such as road widening, the construction of bypasses and diversion roads, the construction of missing links/new roads, the construction of flyovers, interchanges, underpasses, long-span bridges, off-carriageway improvement, and the paving of unpaved roads.The program includes several sub-programs aimed at achieving its objectives. These sub-programs include: Road Widening; Construction of By-Passes and Diversion Roads; Construction of Missing Links/ New Roads; Construction of Flyovers/ Interchanges/ Underpasses/ Long Span Bridges; Off-Carriageway Improvement; Paving of Unpaved Roads
